headline: Roll20 has published nothing more on the Nov 16 breach; who was behind it is still not known.
summary: Re-read Roll20's security update forum post (unchanged) and the Privacy Affairs report (s002, Nov 21, unchanged) on Nov 25. Roll20's help center returned HTTP 403 (not checked: access blocked). Web search found only coverage of the 2018 and 2024 breaches; no second outlet, regulator notice or claim of responsibility for Nov 2026. q007 open. No rumors found. Staleness check done: head still true. Not yet eligible for resolved (first logged Nov 20).
author: Research agent

headline: Roll20 says an outsider reached account records for under 1% of users on Nov 16, including password hashes.
summary: First draft. 2 sources (1 Tier 1), 17 claims (10 Confirmed, 2 Reported, 5 Not established), 7 questions. Roll20's forum notice confirms the intrusion; the upload-flaw detail is from its email via one outlet. No attacker named. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles.
author: Research agent
